table_cells.text: 1.  Quality of the blended learning approach

Tenderers must submit a document in A4 format of no more  than 2,000 words containing a proposal for a blended learning  concept in response to the exercise in Annex F - Exercises.    The following aspects will be used to assess quality:  1.  the approach takes into account key challenges and  learning objectives;  2.  it proposes a blend of solutions adapted to the needs  of  the  target  group  and  ensures  effective  learning  transfer;  3.  the  content  and  methods  are  consistent  and  complementary across the  various  learning  formats  proposed;  4.  the  tools  proposed  ensure  that  pre-requisites  are  completed on time and allow effective evaluation of the  impact of the blended learning approach.
2. Quality of the proposal for a classroom course as part  of the blended learning approach

Tenderers must submit a document in A4 format of no more  than  2,000  words  describing a  1-day  classroom course in  response to the exercise in Annex F - Exercises.    The following aspects will be used to assess quality:  1.  the learning objectives are clear and suitable for the  target group;  2.  the course methodology, timing and evaluation tools  are appropriate;  3.  the  course  is  dynamic,  interactive  and  promotes  exchange among participants;  4.  the proposed examples, case studies and/or exercises  are practical and relevant.
